columns.name: SR_AGG_ID
columns.description: Surrogate key, populated by sequence SVC_SR_AGG_SEQ

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SR_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS.

columns.name: STRIPE_CD
columns.description: Application stripe code. Used for application striping.

columns.name: LAST_STATUS_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Values of the service request's STATUS_TYPE_CD column at the time of the last aggregation.

columns.name: SR_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Value of the service request's LAST_UPDATE_DATE column at the time of the last aggregation.

columns.name: INTERACTION_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Timestamp of the last update date of the interactions associated to this service request.

columns.name: MILESTONE_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Latest update date of milestones associated to this service request at the time of the last aggregation.

columns.name: RESOLVED_INTERACTIONS
columns.description: Number of interactions between the service request's creation date and the service request's SR_LAST_RESOLVED_DATE.

columns.name: RESOLVED_CHANNEL_ID
columns.description: Id of the channel of the last interaction before the service request's SR_LAST_RESOLVED_DATE.

columns.name: RESOLVED_AGENT_ID
columns.description: Id of the agent handling the last interaction before the service request's SR_LAST_RESOLVED_DATE.

columns.name: CLOSED_INTERACTIONS
columns.description: Number of interactions between the service request's creation date and its SR_CLOSE_DATE.

columns.name: CLOSED_CHANNEL_ID
columns.description: Id of the channel of the last interaction before the serivce request's SR_CLOSE_DATE.

columns.name: CLOSED_AGENT_ID
columns.description: Id of the agent handling the last interaction before the service request's SR_CLOSE_DATE.

columns.name: SR_COMPLIANT_FLAG
columns.description: A flag that indicates whether the service request is fully compliant or not.

columns.name: SR_MILESTONE_ASSIGNMENT_FLAG
columns.description: A flag that indicates whether the service request has milestone or not.

columns.name: ARTICLE_LINKED_FLAG
columns.description: A flag that indicates whether or not the service request has one or more knowledge articles associated to it.

columns.name: ARTICLE_RESOLVED_FLAG
columns.description: A flag that indicates whether or not the service request is resolved by one or more knowledge articles that are associated with it.

columns.name: REFERENCE_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Latest update date of references associated to this service request at the time of the last aggregation.

columns.name: AFFECTED_PARTY_FLAG
columns.description: A flag that indicates whether or not the service request has any affected parties associated with it.
